source_level_findings: Authenticity and freshness are distinct predicates. A digest/provenance-valid state can still be old relative to a previously trusted state.

WP901 G3 closes self-attested-principal and mixed-source lineage gaps inside the supplied restart evidence set, but the inspected G3 boundary does not itself compare that set with an independently trusted latest-seen generation/checkpoint.

A local monotonic generation/checkpoint anchor stored only inside the same rollbackable persistence domain can detect partial rollback but cannot, by itself, establish protection against a coherent whole-domain rollback that also restores the anchor.

A TPM monotonic NV counter is a stronger optional freshness witness because it is designed not to decrease across ordinary host-state rollback, but it adds hardware/platform/authorization/write-endurance/availability constraints and is not justified as a mandatory dependency at E1.

An append-only remote/transparency witness can externalize checkpoint freshness without becoming canonical state, but it adds network/privacy/availability/operator/trust complexity and must remain witness-only.

The smallest likely F2 design is therefore not importing TUF, Trillian or a TPM stack. It is a narrow typed FreshnessWitness contract with explicit assurance classification and fail-closed semantics, plus lightweight backends selected by deployment policy.

E1 does not prove that a coherent stale WP901 source set is reachable from the current integrated loader/caller path. That requires E2 architecture mapping and then an F2-specific falsifier/ablation before any integration or runtime credit.
counterhypothesis_note: G3 direct-successor and exact causal/source bindings are strong against internally inconsistent or mixed evidence. They may be sufficient if an upstream caller already supplies a non-rollbackable current causal/freshness anchor. No such guarantee is established by the inspected G3 component itself.
recommended_e2_question: Map the smallest FreshnessWitness boundary onto current WP901/UnifiedDB/restart-loader dependencies and identify whether an existing F2 authority surface already supplies a trustworthy latest-seen anchor, avoiding a duplicate state authority.
